policy.inventory_note: Illustrative registry only. Copy and configure sources/profiles for your own writing notebook; titles are not a required library or evidence of source ownership.

coverage_gaps.route_to: local compilation, logs, and visual inspection

coverage_gaps.topic: Domain-specific models, mechanisms, metrics, thresholds, and statistical adequacy
coverage_gaps.route_to: theory notebook plus current code, data, and domain primary sources

title_aliases: Technical Scientific Paper Revision Rubric v1.0
revision_rubric.description: Defines L0-L10, evidence states, severities, and the conditional IEEE annex; it selects checks but never proves a venue rule or technical claim.

title_aliases: IEEE Reference Style Guide for Authors
ieee_references.description: IEEE in-text citation and bibliography formatting, abbreviations, and reference-type requirements.

knuth_math_writing.description: Mathematical prose, logical exposition, grammatical integration of symbols and displayed equations, and punctuation heuristics.

Science Research Writing for Non-Native Speakers of English
science_research_writing.description: STEM section purposes, introduction-method-results-discussion patterns, paragraph functions, transitions, and evidence-calibrated reporting.

williams_clarity.canonical_title: Style_ Lessons in Clarity and Grace.pdf

Style Lessons in Clarity and Grace
williams_clarity.description: Subject-action alignment, nominalization diagnosis, information flow, cohesion, emphasis, and concision.

successful_academic_writing.description: Reverse outlining, literature organization, structural self-review, and revision tracking support.

effective_peer_review.canonical_title: How to Conduct an Effective Peer Review.pdf
title_aliases: How to Conduct an Effective Peer Review
effective_peer_review.description: Reviewer roles, constructive critique, response tone, and evaluating whether revisions answer review concerns.

peer_review_management.canonical_title: Peer Review and Manuscript Management in Scientific Journals.pdf
title_aliases: Peer Review and Manuscript Management in Scientific Journals
peer_review_management.description: Submission and resubmission workflow, reviewer-response organization, editorial responsibilities, and handling integrity concerns.

review_boundary.description: Define audit scope, available evidence, and limitations.

scope_contribution.description: Audit problem framing, contribution boundaries, novelty rhetoric, and section-level positioning.

mathematical_prose.description: Integrate equations and symbols into clear grammatical and logical exposition; not a validity proof.

method_reproducibility.description: Audit whether procedures and influential parameters are reported reproducibly.

experimental_design_reporting.description: Audit reporting of samples, splits, baselines, ablations, and experimental limitations; domain validity still requires local/theory evidence.

results_claim_calibration.description: Audit results reporting, limitations, statistics language, and evidence-appropriate claim strength.

scientific_structure.description: Audit section roles, ordering, abstraction boundaries, paragraph functions, and transitions.

prose_clarity.description: Audit agency, nominalizations, cohesion, emphasis, concision, and rhetorical precision.

ieee_editorial_compliance.description: Apply general IEEE editorial, metadata, disclosure, and applicable policy requirements.

ieee_math_typesetting.description: Apply IEEE mathematical typography and equation-layout requirements.

ieee_references.description: Audit IEEE citations and bibliography entries.

integrity_compliance.description: Identify relevant integrity questions without presuming a venue policy. For an IEEE target also select ieee_editorial_compliance; for another venue inspect its official policies locally. Do not establish compliance from the rubric alone.

reviewer_response.description: Draft or audit a response letter and revision traceability.

reverse_outline.description: Perform a deliberate reverse-outline or structural revision-tracking exercise.
